title: 钗头凤（世情薄）
author: 唐琬（传）
intro: Said to be Tang Wan’s answer to Lu You’s lyric on the garden wall. She has had to hide her grief from everyone: the refrain is “Hard, hard, hard” — and then “Hide it, hide it, hide it.”
analysis: 传说唐琬看到陆游在沈园墙上题的《钗头凤》，也用同一个词牌和了这首，不久就郁郁而终。上阕：世态人情凉薄又险恶，就像黄昏时的雨，花很容易被打落——她自己就是那朵被风雨摧残的花。早上的风吹干了泪水，泪痕还在；想把心事写下来，却只能靠着栏杆自言自语。“难、难、难”。下阕：我们已经各自成家，今天不再是从前；我的病中魂魄像秋千的绳子一样晃来晃去，没有着落。夜里号角声凄寒，夜快尽了；怕别人问起，只好咽下眼泪，装出高兴的样子。“瞒、瞒、瞒”——这是全词最心酸的地方：她连哭都不能让人看见。和陆游那首对读，一个悔恨，一个隐忍，句式相同，声音相应，所以常被放在一起。
analysisEn: Legend says that Tang Wan saw the lyric Lu You had written on the wall of the Shen Garden and answered it with this one, to the same tune — and died of grief not long after. The first half: the world is cold and people are cruel, like evening rain that easily knocks the blossoms down; she is that battered flower. The morning wind has dried her tears, but the stains remain. She wants to write down what is in her heart, yet can only lean on the railing and talk to herself. “Hard, hard, hard.” The second half: they each belong to someone else now, and today is not yesterday. Her sick spirit swings back and forth like the rope of a swing, with nothing to hold on to. The night bugle sounds cold; the night is nearly over. Afraid that someone will ask, she swallows her tears and puts on a cheerful face. “Hide it, hide it, hide it” — the saddest part of the poem: she is not even allowed to be seen crying. Read beside Lu You’s lyric, one voice is full of regret and the other of endurance, in matching lines that answer each other — which is why the two are always printed together.
background: Tang Wan (dates unknown, 12th century) was Lu You’s first wife, divorced at his mother’s insistence. Song sources quote only two lines of a reply by her; the full text appears much later, so many scholars think it was completed or written by someone else. The attribution is traditional.
pronunciation: 晓风干 gān；欲笺 jiān；斜阑 xié lán；人成各 gè；秋千索 suǒ；角声 jiǎo；阑珊 lán shān；咽泪 yàn（吞下）；瞒 mán。“干”“咽”机器朗读易误，已在朗读用字中替换同音字，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行文本。宋人笔记只记“世情薄，人情恶”等残句，全词见于后世笔记，归属存疑，网站署“唐琬（传）”。

lines.zh: 世情薄，人情恶，雨送黄昏花易落。
lines.rhythm: 世情薄，人情恶，雨送/黄昏/花易落
lines.py: shì qíng bó, rén qíng è, yǔ sòng huáng hūn huā yì luò
lines.lit: The ways of the world are thin, human feelings cruel; rain sees off the dusk, flowers fall easily.
lines.en: The world is cold and people are cruel; evening rain, and the flowers fall so easily.

lines.py: xiǎo fēng gān, lèi hén cán
lines.lit: The dawn wind dries them; tear traces remain.
lines.en: The dawn wind dries my face, but the tear stains stay.

lines.py: yù jiān xīn shì, dú yǔ xié lán
lines.lit: I want to write my heart on paper; alone I talk, leaning on the slanting rail.
lines.en: I want to write you what I feel, but only murmur to myself, leaning on the rail.
So hard — so hard — so hard.

lines.zh: 人成各，今非昨，病魂常似秋千索。
lines.rhythm: 人成各，今非昨，病魂/常似/秋千索
lines.py: rén chéng gè, jīn fēi zuó, bìng hún cháng sì qiū qiān suǒ
lines.lit: We have become separate; today is not yesterday; my sick soul is often like a swing’s rope.
lines.en: We belong to others now; today is not the past. My sick heart swings like a swing-rope, back and forth.

lines.py: jiǎo shēng hán, yè lán shān
lines.lit: The horn’s sound is cold; the night is waning.
lines.en: A cold bugle call; the night is wearing thin.

lines.py: pà rén xún wèn, yàn lèi zhuāng huān
lines.lit: Afraid people will ask, I swallow my tears and pretend to be happy.
lines.en: Afraid that someone will ask, I swallow my tears and smile.
Hide it — hide it — hide it.

words.note: 晓：天刚亮。现代汉语“拂晓”。
名词是“信纸”，现代汉语“信笺”。
各：各自，现代汉语“各自”“各奔东西”。
现代汉语“灯火阑珊”“意兴阑珊”。
咽：吞下，读 yàn；现代汉语“咽下去”。

imagery.name: 雨
imagery.zh: 黄昏的雨象征冷酷的世态人情，无情地摧残着她。
imagery.en: Evening rain stands for a cold, cruel world that batters her without pity.

imagery.name: 落花
imagery.zh: 被雨打落的花就是她自己：美好却脆弱，经不起风雨。
imagery.en: The rain-struck flower is herself — lovely, fragile, unable to weather the storm.

imagery.name: 泪
imagery.zh: 风吹干了泪，却擦不掉泪痕；最后连泪都只能咽下去。
imagery.en: The wind dries her tears but not their traces; in the end she must swallow them unseen.

imagery.name: 秋千
imagery.zh: 晃动不停的秋千绳，比喻她病中恍惚、无依无靠的心。
imagery.en: A swing-rope that never stops moving: her sick, restless heart with nothing to hold on to.
